subject: Re: DVRL kickoff - data valuation as a product surface
body:
Lucia,

Staffing and resource plan, as promised.

People: Wei 80% on the data value estimator and reward shaping, Rosa 50% on the pipeline and eval harness, Gustavo 70% on data tooling. That's tight but workable for a June 8 demo.

The big gap is test data. To stress corrupted-sample discovery at controlled noise rates we need clean, labeled synthetic corpora we can corrupt on demand. Nothing internal fits, so I want us to scope and staff a synthetic-data generation pipeline from scratch: Gustavo owns the design, Rosa pairs on the serving path, and I'm budgeting six weeks of build time before the DVRL reward loop can consume it. It's a real chunk of the schedule but it de-risks every downstream eval.

Compute is modest: Titan A100 best-effort covers training, no Vulcan reservation needed. I'll file the Corpus ingestion request for the tabular benchmarks this week.

Deshawn
